snippet.title: Can you cook my last meal? | Official trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4924160
You are assigned as a chef responsible for preparing meals for death row inmates.

You will meet them before their executions.
Read each prisoner’s profile.
Choose which ingredients to cook with.
Prepare the meal and serve it to the death row inmate.

When the meal is over, send them on to the final procedure.

In the moments before execution, how will you treat the death row inmate?
What will you say to them?
